LanguageData.CC_PeoplesD_BeastGone: {0} is no longer on the colony's land.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesD_NoHunter: Nobody at home can hunt it now.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesD_HuntGivenUp: The Wardens of {0} have given up the hunt for {1} and are walking home; its page in their book stays open.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesD_Skinned: {PAWN_nameDef} of the Wardens skinned {BEAST} where it fell: the hide goes into their book, and {KEPT} is left there for the colony.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesD_Impact_HuntTogether: The Wardens and {1} go after {0} at once; if it falls, a Warden skins it there, the hide theirs and the meat the colony's.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesD_Impact_HuntAlone: The Wardens go after {0} at once; if it falls, one of them skins it there, the hide theirs and the meat the colony's.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesD_BellRung: {0} heard that the bell-keepers of {1} rang for their dead at the colony.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesD_NoBout: Nobody can take the bout now.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesD_Impact_Bout: {0} spars with {1} by the Fighting-type spar's rules, practice blows each way, the bout's winner by {0}'s way with beasts and hands.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesD_Impact_BoutRisk: Now and then the companion's blow lands: {0} may take a bruise.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesD_BoutWon: {PAWN_nameDef} beat {PET} fairly in a friendly bout. {TAMER} tied a token on the sash for it and handed over an egg of the Circuit's hatchery.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesD_BoutLost: {PET} had the better of {PAWN_nameDef} in a friendly bout, and {TAMER} says the next one is {PAWN_nameDef}'s to win.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesD_BoutBlow: {PET}'s blow landed in the bout: {PAWN_nameDef} has a bruised {PART}.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesD_NoEgg: The colony has no fertile egg of its own in its stores to swap.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesD_StrayGone: {0} is no longer at the gate.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesD_Impact_StrayBack: {0} is the colony's again, there at the gate where the ranger hands over the lead.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesD_StrayHome: {PET_nameDef} is home: {RANGER} of the Circuit handed over the lead at the gate.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesD_ScrapSlag: {0} chunks of slag and {1} broken clothes and weapons
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesD_ScrapBroken: {0} clothes and weapons too far gone to wear
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesD_NoPiece: The Wheel has nothing mended of the colony's kind to trade.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesD_ScrapGone: The scrap is no longer lying about.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesD_Impact_StripShare: The Wheel's runners strip the {0} where it lies for three hours, and half of each part is left there for the colony.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesD_Impact_StripSold: The Wheel's runners strip the {0} where it lies for three hours and take every part.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesD_Stripped: {PAWN_nameDef} of the Wheel stripped the {WRECK}: half the parts went into the Wheel's packs, and {KEPT} is left there for the colony.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesD_StrippedSold: {PAWN_nameDef} of the Wheel stripped the {WRECK} the colony sold them, and the parts went into the Wheel's packs.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesD_WheelMoved: The Wheel's yard {0} has moved on to new ground, as {1} always do.
